function: Jointly learns stacked-metasurface (SIM) phase shifts, i.e. wave-domain beamforming, and transmit power allocation to maximize the downlink multi-user sum rate (p. 3, 6).
system: Downlink MISO: BS with M=4 antennas, four single-antenna UEs, stacked SIM with L=4 layers of N=49 meta-atoms integrated at the BS; 28 GHz (p. 4, 10).
method: DDPG actor-critic deep reinforcement learning: residual CNN branch for phase shifts, dense branch for power; online interaction, no labeled data; whitening noise on actions (p. 3, 7-8).
data_channel: Own simulator: spatially correlated Rician channel, path-loss exponent 3.5, UEs placed randomly in an annulus every episode; no dataset or measurements (p. 5, 10).
test_conditions: Policy trained online on i.i.d. channel samples; results averaged over 100 random realizations; sweeps of power, layers, meta-atoms, streams and pilot-power CSI error; no separate unseen scenario (p. 6, 11-12).
baselines: Non-learned: AO (water-filling plus gradient ascent), random SIM phases, random-codebook search, fully digital MMSE, hybrid precoding. Learned: only DRL-UPA, a variant of the proposed method (p. 10-11).
metrics: Average sum rate (bps/Hz) versus power, antennas, layers and meta-atoms; reward convergence; training stability; gains of 38.5% over hybrid and 2 bps/Hz over AO (p. 11-14).
complexity: Complexity orders derived for training and prediction, linear in meta-atoms and layers, versus AO O(M^2 N^4 + M N^3 L) (p. 9-10).
q1_support: p. 5: "we consider the Rician channel model"; custom spatially correlated Rician model with its own path loss and Rician factor (p. 10); no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO, QuaDRiGa or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 12: "To evaluate the performance of the proposed DRL scheme under imperfect CSI"; this is a CSI-error sweep; the other sweeps (power, layers, meta-atoms, streams) change the state and action sizes (p. 6, Eqs. 16-17), and no train-test mismatch is stated.
q3_support: p. 10: "we consider the following four benchmark schemes for comparison"; DRL-UPA (the proposed DRL with uniform power, a variant), Random, Codebook and AO (p. 10-11), plus MMSE and hybrid precoding (p. 11); no earlier learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 10: "exhibits linear scaling with the number of meta-atoms and layers"; Section III-D derives the complexity orders of training and prediction (p. 9-10) and gives AO as O(M^2 N^4 + M N^3 L) (p. 10).
q5_support: p. 10: "The M UEs are randomly distributed in an annular region"; channels are simulated (p. 5, 10) and no code or data link, DOI or public dataset is given.
notes: Preprint arXiv 2408.04837v2 (p. 1). The stacked intelligent metasurface counts as a RIS of the stacked type. The output of scripts/pdf_text.py for this file shifts and truncates pages 11-15 because of stray form feeds from figure fonts; pages cited here are the real PDF pages, read from the page images and from a per-page extraction. The only learned baseline, DRL-UPA, is a variant of the proposed method, so q3 is 0.
